plans.idea: Faithful story stack: brand mark top-left and NEW VIDEO sticker top-right share a header row, a big left-aligned headline beneath, and the bottle fills the full width of the lower 60% so the product finally dominates instead of floating small.

Product-first poster: the bottle leads at the top at near full width, then the NEW VIDEO tag sits directly above the headline as one centred caption group, with the brand mark signing off at the bottom centre.

Centred single-axis read: the brand mark sits centred at the top, a full-width headline below it, then the NEW VIDEO sticker hangs off the bottle's top-right corner like it does in the original, above a large hero filling the bottom.
